title: The Silent Bell
premise: A harbor apprentice discovers that the city's rescue bell is being silenced before a storm. Her guardian is implicated, but exposing him may leave the harbor without its only trained bell keeper.
reader_experience: Tense investigation with a hopeful but costly resolution
pov: limited third person, Mara, past tense

characters.name: Oren
characters.goal: protect Mara and conceal his debt
characters.voice: practical warnings and evasive short answers

world_rules: The rescue bell requires a physical keeper to sound it.
A storm is expected by the third night.
No magic can restore a severed rope.

initial_facts.text: Oren trained Mara to inspect the bell mechanism.
Oren owes a private debt to the harbor collector.

must_avoid: Instant reconciliation without a consequential choice
retrieval_query: conflicting loyalty evidence discovery responsibility debt rescue consequences
